title: RNAseq analysis of blood from influenza infected patients and healthy controls SIG-2018
description: Gene expression changes in the blood was studied by RNAseq; project SIG-2018 Results: Strong differential host reponse after infection with influenza virus compared to healthy controls Overall design: Peripheral blood was collected from patients, RNA was isolated and sequenced.
